chapter: Big band, Chicago players, recordings and gospel
title: Records with Lil Armstrong and Okeh, and his own name with Joe Williams
summary: He recorded with Lil Armstrong's Decca band in the 1930s and in the late 1940s began recording for Okeh under his own name, including with Joe Williams.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
